A '''refugee base''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] it and engaged [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] troops there.
